name: Schleiden’s plant-cell account
description: Matthias Schleiden argued that plant tissues are composed of cells and gave an early account of their development.

date.basis: Date of the cited publication or documented episode; not a claim that the underlying work began that year.

events.statement: Schleiden’s 1838 plant-development paper advanced a cellular account of plant tissues.
events.scope: Matthias Schleiden argued that plant tissues are composed of cells and gave an early account of their development.
events.caveats: His account included a now-rejected explanation of cell formation; its publication did not establish immediate universal acceptance.

evidence.supports: Attributes a plant cellular account to Schleiden and lists his 1838 paper.
Dates the plant-tissue claim to 1838 and identifies a mistaken view of cell origin.
